explication: iFixAi is a tool for independently auditing AI agents against organizational and operational expectations, combining adversarial testing with assurance checks. The main workflow configures a target agent and judge, loads a fixture, runs selected inspections, evaluates evidence, scores results, and produces reports and a scorecard. CLI, API, and agent-plugin usage are documented entry routes. The README documents the product flow and capabilities; source excerpts and index references support several internal links, but many inspection implementations and report paths were not sampled, so those connections are documented rather than inferred from names.
